name: Hugo
summary: Substantially AI-generated contributions must be disclosed in the PR with their extent, stay narrowly scoped for non-maintainers, and be understood and verified by the contributor.

evidence.quote: If a substantial part of your contribution is autogenerated with AI, this must be disclosed in the pull request, along with the extent to which AI assistance was used.
AI contributions from non-maintainers needs to have a fairly narrow scope (e.g. a bug fix), as we have limited review capacity.
We expect contributors to understand the code that is produced and be able to answer critical questions about it
